eval.description: OpenAI agentic eval of wet-lab assistant actions through a computer or browser harness (including Ranger). Tasks cover common lab-assistant steps such as using biological design tools, retrieving reference sequences, and placing synthesis orders. Scored as pass@10 success rate per task. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures whether AI agents can complete wet-lab assistant tasks, such as using biological design tools and ordering synthesis.

links.title: OpenAI o1 system card (Biotool and Wet Lab Actions)

versions.changes: Cards report three browser or tool tasks with pass@10 over 10 rollouts; custom and Ranger scaffolds.

scores.description: The agent completed the assigned wet-lab tooling or ordering task on that rollout.

metrics.description: Success rate over 10 rollouts, reported per task.
